title: B-tree Pager maximum-page-count delegation

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeMaxPageCount serializes access through the B-tree owner, delegates the requested maximum to Pager, and returns Pager's resulting maximum.

external_source_responsibilities: Typed Pager owner implements sqlite3PagerMaxPageCount semantics
Caller preserves B-tree serialization around the bounded seam
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete delegation/return boundary is assigned and the production Pager maximum operation exists.

inputs: B-tree, requested page maximum, Pager context, and typed Pager maximum callback
contracts.ownership: B-tree and Pager context are borrowed.
contracts.state_and_results: Forwards request exactly once and returns callback result unchanged; zero remains a query request.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Invokes one Pager callback. Source enters/leaves B-tree mutex around it; bounded caller owns equivalent serialization.

representation_differences: The internal B-tree module receives Pager operation/context as a typed callback rather than retaining a direct Pager pointer; caller owns mutex serialization.

oracle.protocol: Start maximum 8, request 12 and observe 12, then query with zero and observe unchanged 12.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; B-tree serialization integration remains pending.
assurance.continuation: Pager maximum remains queryable and updateable.
assurance.performance: Constant time plus one Pager callback.

integration.native_call_path: Typed callback targets pager_core.maxPageCount; direct B-tree/Pager serialization seam remains to be connected in a shared container.

independent_review.notes: Requires native seam trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect and trace the typed Pager maximum callback under actual B-tree serialization.
